name: CYCLETRACK 骑迹 Phantom 魅影 / L-TWOO RX 24-speed
why_interesting: Current manufacturer and mainland indexes establish Phantom / 魅影 as the model and L-TWOO RX 24-speed as the drivetrain; RX is not a model suffix.

facts.frame_material: Carbon frame and carbon fork; the exact current RX 24-speed page does not publish a fiber grade, and conflicting T700, T800 and T1000 claims from other Phantom generations or trims are not assigned
facts.frame_construction: Aero road frame with fully internal cable routing and hydraulic flat-mount disc brakes
facts.drivetrain: L-TWOO RX 24-speed, SENICX PR1 34/50 crank, ATA cassette and KMC chain; the current exact-model manufacturer page does not explicitly label shift actuation as mechanical
facts.reference_builds: The exact official L-TWOO RX 24-speed/alloy-rim reference page lists an approximate 8.5 kg and sizes 44/48/52 cm, but does not link the mass to a size or state pedal inclusion or weighing method; a separate Shimano 105 alloy-wheel build was independently reported at 8.7 kg.
facts.stiffness_evidence: No exact-model numeric stiffness result or sufficiently specific independent frame-stiffness assessment was found across the 50-area sweep
